subject: You’re invited to the Modwerk beta
body:
Hi,

I’ve been working on new features for Modwerk, and I’d love to have you try them. Join the beta to test Octatrack USB loading and new modules before they’re available to everyone.

The tester pool is limited to 50 people.

[Join the beta]({{beta-invitation}})

You’ll find the details and risks on the site. Come say hi on our development Discord and let me know what you think.

See you around,
Jannik
